policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors require Turkmenistan's visa in advance through a consulate or embassy.
conditions: An airport or port visa is available only where included in the invitation; that conditional route does not displace the normal advance-visa baseline.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport tourists can obtain Djibouti's eVisa online before travel, and it is delivered by email.
conditions: The tourist eVisa requires the listed travel, accommodation or invitation, passport-scan and photo materials before travel.
This excludes work, study, special documents and final admission.

application.label: Djibouti official eVisa service
steps: Submit the ordinary Polish-passport tourist application online before travel.
Print and carry the eVisa delivered by email.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Jordan's single-entry stay visa at international border crossings.
conditions: The King Hussein/Allenby Bridge does not issue this visa, but that crossing-specific exception does not displace the international-crossing arrival route.
This excludes multiple-entry, work, residence, special documents and final admission.

conflicts.explanation: Current Polish MFA guidance says the ordinary tourist eVisa is delivered by email before travel and says no visa can be obtained at neighbouring-country border crossings.

unresolved.reason: Sierra Leone's live service exposes Polish eVisa products and says accepted eVisas are emailed, but the same current service also says visas are issued at the airport or border.
